jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer, Emergency Call Handling
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


**Aperçu de l’entreprise**

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez\-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez\-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

Emergency Call Handling is the critical interface for the citizen into the command center, public safety workflow. We are the leading solution provider for Emergency Call Handling, the software that enables 911 call centers to receive and process calls in Public Safety Answering Points across North America. We are part of the Motorola Solutions Software Enterprise, where innovation of workflow enhancements are being developed for call handling, incident management, responder dispatching and situational awareness. This software developer position will be a member of the team working on software applications for Public Safety.
  

  

Présentation du département:
  

La gestion des appels d'urgence est l'interface essentielle du citoyen avec le centre de commandement et le flux de travail de la sécurité publique. Nous sommes le principal fournisseur de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence, le logiciel qui permet aux centres d'appels 911 de recevoir et de traiter les appels dans les centres d'appels de la sécurité publique (CASP) à travers l'Amérique du Nord. Nous faisons partie de la division Logiciels d'entreprise (Software Enterprise) de Motorola Solutions, où sont développées des innovations pour améliorer les flux de travail liés à la gestion des appels, à la gestion des incidents, à la répartition des intervenants et à la connaissance de la situation. Ce poste de développeur de logiciels fait partie de l'équipe travaillant sur des applications logicielles pour la sécurité publique.
**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the team developing the VESTA 9\-1\-1 Call Handling solution. In this role, you will leverage agentic AI to build applications, automate DevOps and Cybersecurity workflows, improving quality and operational efficiency.  



  

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers across real\-time pipelines, telephony, backend infrastructure, and product surfaces. You’ll help influence architecture, build core product features, and shape how our team uses AI agents to move faster without compromising reliability, security, or product quality. We encourage engineers to use AI agents in their own work. But because this is mission\-critical software, humans still own quality, judgment, and what ships.

  

  

What You’ll Do


* Develop components for and integrate services into our Emergency Call Handling Systems
* Develop Agentic AI\-powered automation workflows to improve efficiency of our DevOps and Cybersecurity tasks.
* Help integrate AI techniques to improve evaluation, testing, and observability for our systems.
* Get your hands dirty setting up and configuring hardware and software, including network devices and servers.
* Build strong habits around tests, code review, observability, and security from day one.
* Ask questions, dig into how things work, and bring fresh perspectives to the team.
  

  

You Might Be a Fit If


* You enjoy converting manual, tedious procedures to autonomous AI\-powered workflows then jumping onto the next high\-impact challenge.
* You’re curious about working across backend, infrastructure, AI, and product, even if you haven’t done it all yet.
* You use AI tools daily, but you do not confuse speed with quality.
* You care about quality — you write tests, read documentation, and try to understand a system before you change it.
* You take feedback well and act on it.
* You have strong product instincts and care about the humans using what you build.
* You thrive in a team where you’ll have real ownership early — and you’re comfortable asking for help.
  

  

Relevant Experience


We don’t expect you to have shipped production systems. We care most about engineering fundamentals, learning velocity, curiosity, and how you think. Coursework, internships, research, and personal projects all count.


Relevant exposure may include:


* Projects involving AI agents, AI pipelines or RAG systems.
* Real\-time communication systems using WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, media streaming, or low\-latency audio transport.
* Exposure to DevOps, Automation and CI/CD systems using tools such as TeamCity, Jenkins, Github, Artifactory
* Programming in Python, C\#, C\+\+, Java, or similar languages
* Comfortable scripting in both Linux and Windows and virtualization.
* Telephony and voice infrastructure, including PSTN, SIP trunking, PBX, and call routing.
  

  

You do not need experience in all of these areas. Most successful candidates will have experience in a few and curiosity to learn the rest.

  

  

Target Base Salary Range: $70,000 \- $90,000 CAD


Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
***Full stack developer \- Long Term Care Home Apps***

Are you a new graduate or early\-career developer who wants to build technology that directly supports resident care, clinical teams, and healthcare operations? This is an opportunity to apply your full\-stack development skills in a meaningful environment where your work can improve documentation, workflows, reporting, inventory management, and quality improvement in long\-term care.

We are looking for a motivated Full\-Stack Developer to help design, build, and improve secure, user\-friendly clinical applications. You will work closely with clinical, quality, administrative, and operational stakeholders to understand real\-world needs and turn them into practical digital solutions.

**What You’ll Do**

· Build, maintain, and improve full\-stack web applications used in clinical and long\-term care operations.

· Develop intuitive, accessible interfaces for nurses, care teams, managers, and administrative users.

· Design APIs, data models, dashboards, forms, and reporting workflows.

· Integrate applications with existing systems, databases, and operational data sources.

· Support privacy\-conscious handling of sensitive healthcare information in alignment with Ontario healthcare expectations.

· Explore automation, anonymization, analytics, and responsible AI\-assisted workflows to reduce manual work and improve decision\-making.

· Improve application reliability, usability, accessibility, performance, and security.

· Document technical decisions, architecture, testing processes, and user workflows.

· Identify technical debt and contribute to scalable, maintainable development practices.

· Collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements and deliver solutions that fit real clinical and operational workflows.

**What We’re Looking For**

· Recent graduate or early\-career developer with education or project experience in software development, computer science, information technology, or a related field.

· Comfortable working across both frontend and backend development, with a willingness to learn new tools and frameworks.

· Experience through coursework, internships, co\-op placements, capstone projects, personal projects, or open\-source contributions.

· Knowledge of web application development, databases, APIs, version control, testing, and debugging.

· Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to translate user needs into practical technical solutions.

· Clear communication skills and confidence working with non\-technical users, good in change management for end users and ensure adoption.

· Interest in healthcare, long\-term care, clinical workflows, quality improvement, automation, and emerging technologies.

· A careful, responsible approach to privacy, security, accessibility, and documentation.

**Helpful Skills and Technologies**

· Frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue, or similar.

· Backend development using Node.js, .NET, Java, Python, or similar technologies.

· Relational or non\-relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar.

· API development, authentication, role\-based access, and secure coding concepts.

· Reporting, dashboards, data visualization, workflow automation, or AI\-assisted tools.

· Understanding of accessibility, usability, testing, and documentation best practices.

· Understanding of Artificial intelligence, AI coding.

**Why Join Us?**

· Build software that supports frontline healthcare teams and directly contributes to better resident care.

· Gain hands\-on experience with real clinical, operational, reporting, and quality improvement challenges.

· Work closely with experienced healthcare professionals and learn how technology is applied in long\-term care.

· Contribute ideas, experiment with emerging technologies, and help modernize healthcare workflows.

· Grow your portfolio with meaningful projects that combine software development, healthcare operations, privacy, and innovation.

If you are curious, motivated, and excited to use technology to solve practical healthcare problems, we would love to hear from you. New graduates and candidates with strong project experience are encouraged to apply.

*Primacare Living Solutions Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all interested parties. We are pleased to accommodate individual needs of job applicants throughout the recruitment and selection process in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility of Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 (AODA). If you require accommodation at any time throughout the recruitment process, please speak with the Hiring Manager.*

***This posting is for a current vacancy.***  
***Artificial intelligence (AI) may be used as part of the applicant screening process.***

Pay: From $42,900\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**About Presto Phoenix, Inc.**
------------------------------


Presto is the leading Voice AI company for restaurant drive\-thrus, operating at scale in complex, noisy, customer\-facing environments. As the AI partner to more than a dozen of the most iconic American restaurant brands, Presto is building one of the most impactful real\-world applications of AI that directly impacts revenue, labor efficiency, and a magical guest experience for millions of people.


AI is not a feature at Presto; it is the foundation of how we build, evaluate, and evolve our products. We operate at lightning\-speed iteration cycles and are solving some of the hardest problems in Voice AI. We are backed by Remus Capital, were a Y Combinator company, and are headquartered in Silicon Valley.


This may not be the right fit for you if you are looking for a traditional 9\-to\-5 environment. We move at the pace of AI. Change is constant, and roadmaps evolve quickly. Presto is for builders, experimenters, and problem\-solvers who thrive in ambiguity, learn continuously, and are excited to shape the future of real\-world AI alongside a high\-performance team.

**The Role**
------------


We are looking for a **Web Developer** to help build the interfaces and web experiences that power Presto's Voice AI platform, from internal operator dashboards to customer\-facing configuration tools. This is a hands\-on engineering role where you will write production React code that real restaurant operators and internal teams rely on every day.


You will work closely with backend, AI, and product teams to translate business requirements into clean, responsive, and reliable user interfaces. You are someone who cares about code quality, is comfortable moving quickly, and wants to grow your skills across the full front\-end stack in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment.


Success in this role requires strong fundamentals in modern web development, an ownership mindset, and the ability to move quickly from design to production.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Build and maintain production web applications**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain responsive front\-end applications using React, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Build reusable, efficient React components and maintain clean state management practices.
* Work across the full front\-end lifecycle, from prototyping through production deployment and monitoring.
* Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate REST and GraphQL APIs into front end applications.

**Apply strong engineering fundamentals**

* Write clean, well\-tested, maintainable code and participate in peer code reviews.
* Apply disciplined coding practices, version control, and testing standards to support fast, reliable releases.
* Debug issues across the stack and boost the overall efficiency and reliability of the software.
* Contribute to system design discussions and help define front end architecture and best practices.

**Work with modern tooling and APIs**

* Build against GraphQL and REST API layers, working closely with backend teams on contract design.
* Use Node.js for tooling, light backend services, and build processes as needed.
* Stay current on front end tooling, frameworks, and techniques, and bring improvements back to the team.

**Collaborate across teams**

* Work closely with product, design, AI, and backend teams to deliver new features end\-to\-end.
* Translate business and operator needs into practical, scalable front\-end solutions.
* Communicate technical tradeoffs and progress clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Solid hands\-on experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as core front end languages.
* Hands\-on experience building applications with React.
* Experience with Node.js for tooling, services, or full\-stack work.
* Experience integrating front end applications with GraphQL and REST API layers.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals: data structures, debugging, and testing.
* Ability to work in fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environments with a high degree of ownership.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable working asynchronously across time zones.
* Experience with responsive, mobile\-first design and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Experience with accessibility standards and testing (e.g., WCAG 2\.1\).
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools and workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Experience working on real\-time or data\-heavy dashboards and interfaces.
* Prior experience at a high\-growth startup or AI\-native company.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Nice to Have**
----------------

**Why Presto**
--------------


We move at the speed of AI. Change is constant, and iteration is rapid. This is not a traditional environment. Success requires adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to solve problems in real time.


This is a high\-ownership environment where engineers have direct impact on real\-world systems operating at scale. You'll work on technology that is deployed in live customer environments and directly drives business outcomes.

**Compensation \& Benefits**
----------------------------


The Canada base salary range for this position is approximately CAD $55K\-$92K annually, plus equity and benefits. Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and individual experience. Presto's compensation philosophy rewards high performers and aligns incentives with long\-term value creation.


Benefits for Canada\-based employees include medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) program, and paid time off (PTO). Learn more at www.presto.com.

**Our Commitment**
------------------


We value people from all walks of life and are committed to building an inclusive and equitable work environment. We strongly encourage candidates from historically underrepresented backgrounds to apply.

**Description** We are seeking a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to embed directly with our Investment, Client \& Support teams, to understand their workflows first\-hand, and build AI\-powered solutions that deliver measurable and tangible value.
  

  

This is a hands\-on, delivery\-focused role. You will scope and prototype rapidly, validate with the business, and ship production\-grade solutions spanning automation, workflow orchestration, and client\-facing tooling — using AI\-native tooling across the entire lifecycle, from design and testing through to documentation. You will build on platforms such as Microsoft (Copilot, Cowork, Studio, Foundry) then work with engineering and the broader AI platform team to generalize what you learn into reusable platform capabilities.
  

  

The successful candidate combines strong business understanding across asset management with genuine software\-engineering depth and daily fluency in AI\-native development tools. You will be equally comfortable distilling an ambiguous business problem, writing production code, and teaching a team to use AI effectively and responsibly.
  

  

**The Opportunity**
  

* Apply cutting\-edge AI to complex professional settings and retail and banking, developing deep expertise with leading LLMs.
* Build intimate domain expertise in how our users so that solutions fit the real workflow.
* Become a core, trusted AI advisor to our stakeholders, driving adoption, value, and growth.
* Optimise processes for scale by defining and continually enhancing the internal workflows that shape and improve how we work.
* Own problems in ambiguity, operating with autonomy in fast\-moving, unstructured environments — quickly distilling complex problems, learning on the fly, and driving to actionable solutions across customer and product needs.

**Key Responsibilities**  

Solution design \& delivery
* Understand the business problem first, then leverage AI tools to accelerate solution design, building analytics and modelling solutions grounded in domain expertise.
* Partner with Business stakeholders, and architects to design, prototype, and deliver AI\-powered solutions spanning automation, workflow orchestration, and client\-facing tooling.
* Run tasks end\-to\-end, from scoping and prototyping through to deployment, using AI\-native tooling throughout — not just for coding, but across design, testing, and documentation.
* Write production code that deploys through our pipelines and meets our engineering standards.
* Build custom integrations, workflow automations, and domain\-specific solutions on top of Barings AI platform, including connectors to business data sources and document management systems.
* Prototype fast, validate with the business, iterate, and ship.

Forward\-deployed engagement
* Own the technical relationship with the business team throughout each engagement.
* Support the delivery of investment, client \& operational workflows, identify high\-value AI use cases, and build proofs of concept that demonstrate measurable impact.
* Return from engagements and work with engineering and product to generalize reusable patterns into platform capabilities.
* Participate in architecture discussions alongside core engineering.

Enablement \& training
* Deliver hands\-on training, office hours, demos, and documentation that teach effective and responsible use of AI tooling — including prompting practices, workflow integration, and limitations.

Platform contribution \& feedback loop
* Build and contribute to AI platform architecture standards, including prompt\-engineering patterns, agentic workflow design, and LLM integration guidelines.
* Collaborate with the wider technology and AI Platform teams to specify the dependencies analytical solutions require, such as data, development environments, and tooling.
* Collect, structure, and synthesize user feedback, pain points, and feature requests, translating them into clear requirements and prioritized recommendations for the AI Platform team.
* Identify patterns across teams to surface high\-impact opportunities, quantify potential impact, and highlight use cases with broader applicability across the wider AI organization.

Responsible AI, risk \& control
* Champion responsible AI usage, ensuring deployments adhere to firm policies on data security, model governance, and compliance.
* Demonstrate conformance to all Barings Enterprise Risk Management policies.
* Ensure all development activities are undertaken within the defined control environment.

**Qualifications**  

Required Skills \& Experience
* Software engineering experience with demonstrable, recent use of AI\-native development tools as a core part of your daily workflow.
* Daily proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot.
* Hands\-on LLM integration experience.
* Working knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol), REST APIs, and microservices architecture.
* Cloud platform experience.
* Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar.
* Strong analytical skills — the ability to understand a business problem first, then apply AI tools to accelerate solution design.
* Strong business understanding across asset management, with relevant domain expertise across investments, operations, data, and workflows.
* Initiative and ownership, with a track record of running tasks end\-to\-end with autonomy.

Preferred
* Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork, and Copilot Studio.
* Familiarity with prompt\-engineering patterns and agentic workflow design.
* Experience building connectors to document management systems and enterprise data sources.
* Experience delivering enablement — training, office hours, and documentation — to non\-technical audiences.

jobs.title: Junior Network Administrator
jobs.description:
As a member of the Network Admin/Cyber Security team, you will maintain the company's network infrastructure, end\-user devices, and core office IT systems, ensuring the stability, performance, and security of internal networks and essential business systems. This role carries responsibility across a range of technical areas, from troubleshooting hardware and software issues to supporting network infrastructure and cyber security needs.


The ideal candidate will bring a strong foundation in network hardware and software, a solid understanding of networking and cyber security fundamentals, and the ability to quickly adapt to new tools and technologies. A motivated and resourceful individual who enjoys problem\-solving in a dynamic, team\-oriented environment will thrive in this role.

**Responsibilities:**

* Administration of user accounts and policies for corporate systems (Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Entra, Endpoint Management, PAM, etc.)
* Administration of Windows and Linux servers, including DNS, DHCP, and other core domain and network services
* Provision server and network hardware (Virtual Machines, Network switches, Firewalls)
* Management of server and hardware updates, including patch management and endpoint/server automation (RMM, Puppet, Ansible)
* Process access requests to network resources (network shares, firewall ACLs, etc.)
* Configure and maintain firewall security policies as directed, including UTM profiles, ZTNA rules, VPN, and routing
* Manage backups and perform periodic disaster recovery testing to verify recovery integrity
* Troubleshoot network, server and client related issues
* Manage software licensing, hardware asset tracking, and change control for network and server modifications
* Track and resolve work via ticketing system (JSM/Jira), including project tasks, documentation, and runbooks
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications:**

* Post\-Secondary Degree / Diploma in related field
* Strong knowledge of Windows Server and Active Directory
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 / Entra policies and administration, and Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence, JSM)
* Working knowledge of Linux technologies preferred (OS installation, CLI configuration, essential tools, storage, etc.)
* Strong grasp of networking concepts and experience with network configuration using CLI (IOS or similar)
* Understanding of Security Appliance / VPN / ZTNA configuration and maintenance
* Experience with Fortinet, Ninja One, CyberArk, Azure, Nutanix AHV, Puppet, Ansible an asset
* Excellent organizational and communication skills
* Capable of work under minimal supervision

 **What we Offer:**

* Employer funded benefits program
* Competitive total compensation package
* Work\-Life Balance
* Employee assistance plan
* Employee Discount Platform
* Career Progression
* Casual Work Environment
* Social Events and Sports Teams
* Onsite Counsellor

**Location:** Burlington, Ontario, in\-office  

**Hours:** Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week  

**Vacancy:** This is an existing position  

**Salary Range (Based on relevant Experience):** $65,000 to $72,000 per year.
